## Notes

- Every rule follows the §9.8 A–E category: A rejects; B rejects inside its window; C/D hold; E escalates; knowledge-base “prescribe” items have no rule.
- Medicines (insulin, oral diabetic, NTI, orlistat): repeat list or issued within 3 months → reject; older → confirm stopped; undated → hold.
- Surgery (bariatric, cholecystectomy): within 12 months → reject; older → may prescribe; undated → hold (Macro 1).
- Items not in EDM-WL-01 (VTE/DOACs, haematology, MS, hypercalcaemia, flecainide) are review flags — confirm against EDM-WM-CI-01.
- Strong negation drops a hit; uncertain wording keeps it as review. MTC/MEN2 family history still rejects.
